model_name: Conditional resampling of recorded trades using the selected firm's ledger rules
limitations: Source selection: every path redraws this configuration's recorded funded trades, which already reflect the historical accounts' entry selection and the opportunities they skipped.
Fixed slots: each redrawn trade is placed in one of the study's fixed trade slots (the recorded entry time, exit time and trading day), not where the strategy would have traded on a fresh account.
Shortened liquidation outcomes: a trade cut short when a historical account was lost keeps its shortened result.
Compressed intratrade path: each trade is reduced to its entry, lowest, highest and exit points, so a reversal between them, a missing intermediate observation, is not represented.
not_claimed: not an exact model of a fresh account at either firm
not a regenerated full-strategy scenario; no new strategy research was run
the historical-order parity below is an integration check of the adapter, not proof that other sampled orders are modelled exactly

parameters.sampling: each path draws trade indices with replacement: blocks of 10 consecutive recorded trades at random starts (the fixed-boundary diagnostic's own draw for the first 200 slots; later slots from the extension seed)

slot_and_compression_rules: Slots: the study's own recorded trades of this configuration at this firm, in execution order; each slot keeps its entry instant, exit instant and trading day.
Each path puts one recorded trade's outcome into each slot; a slot whose account refuses entries (finished for the day, or payout processing) is skipped.

Each trade is compressed to entry, lowest equity point, highest equity point and exit (plus the recorded half exit); order of lowest and highest from the record or the stored one-minute bars, otherwise highest first by convention.
Trades an account loss cut short keep their recorded shortened result.
Costs, quantity, tick value, firm terms and processing clock are the saved result's frozen settings.

denominators.average_payouts_among_failed_within_hori: payouts received by accounts that failed before the cutoff ÷ accounts that failed before the cutoff (all paths pooled)
denominators.pooled_net_cash_per_purchased_account: (all paths' payouts received after the split − all account purchases) ÷ all accounts purchased (all paths pooled; not a mean of per-path ratios)
denominators.first_account_shares: share of paths whose FIRST account received a payout first / failed first / neither by the cutoff
denominators.recorded_percentile: (paths with net cash below the recorded net cash + half of ties) ÷ paths
denominators.unresolved: payout requests with no receipt by the cutoff; their amounts are never counted as received

clocks.eligibility: ledger event eligibility_secured: realized balance ≥ retained cushion + minimum request right after a closed trade, account alive and flat; no more entries that day
clocks.request: ledger event requested: at the end of that trading day
clocks.receipt: ledger event received: after the saved processing clock
clocks.trades_to_endpoint: the first account's trades closed at or before the event
clocks.days_to_endpoint: calendar days from the first account's purchase

application_cache_key.terms_digest_function: firm_race.terms_digest(saved firm terms, saved processing clock)
firm_race.terms_digest(saved firm terms, saved processing clock)

all_128_pairs.detail: no saved per-pair receipt exists from the redesign; the existing integration test tests/agents/ifvg_lab/test_firm_race.py asserts that all 128 configuration-and-firm pairs replay exactly and runs in the final full-suite run (see validation_summary.json)

cache_identity.note: each firm's application_cache_key above is the exact key the application stores this default-draw result under (process memory only; never written to a store). A result under another model id or terms digest is refused.

summary_statistics_rules.percentiles: numpy.percentile, linear interpolation (5th, 50th, 95th of path net cash)
summary_statistics_rules.recorded_percentile: (paths with net cash below the recorded value by more than $0.005 + half the paths within $0.005) / paths
summary_statistics_rules.median_trades_and_days_to_eligibility_re: median over paths whose first account reached that event by the cutoff
summary_statistics_rules.median_trades_and_days_to_failure: median over paths whose FIRST account failed before any payout was received (first_account_endpoint == failed)
summary_statistics_rules.endpoint_shares: counts of first_account_endpoint received / failed / open, divided by paths
